reviews.text:
Dawn is extremely trustworthy and I cannot recommend enough for dog boarding. She is very knowledgeable and provides plenty of updates during our dogs stay to keep us reassured. Our dog has separation anxiety but can’t wait to get away from us for her holidays at Dawn’s house which says it all!!!! She loves the companionship from Dawn’s gorgeous dog Obi too.
Thank you Dawn for all you do x
Great dog trainer. And a great friendly group. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend..
Dawn is fantastic - has really helped me with the tools I need to help my dog Milo.
Amazing group and fantastic support and guidance offered
Excellent  dog sitting  service . Highly recommend
Excellent positive training in a great venue. Always loads of happy waggy tailed pups qho sometimes dont want to leave!

Dawn is a great trainer, very patient and gives loads of advice and tips.
The classes  very friendly, and  great fun for both dogs and owners.
We always look forward to the training classes.
I would highly recommend Aurora..
Thank you Dawn & Eric for all the fab advice and making the training full of laughs.

My two cockapoos have stayed with Dawn and family a couple of times now while we've been on holiday. They are very much welcomed into their home! They are very thorough when finding out background information about our dogs and care for them to a great standard. Will use again. We also live that we get regular photo/ video updates!
Amazing lady my pup is coming on leaps and bounds

Dawn is a amazing dog trainer. My dog has been going to the classes for 3 years now and he loves it. He actually runs into the class. She also boards my dog when I go in holiday. I am reassured that he is in good hands. Dawn communicates daily with videos and messages to say what he has been up to whilst away which is reassuring. I wouldn't trust my dog with anyone else. I would highly recommend dawn.

Dawn and Eric are amazing, so patient and both so knowledgeable. They take the time to get to now you and your dog personally and always have a smile on their faces. Would recommend to anyone with a dog.

Dawn is absolutely incredible with my mini Dachshund George. He first started going to Dawn when he was a puppy to do some basic training and for a Dachshund he has become quite obedient, which is unlike the breed! Dawn now looks after him during the day when I am at work sometimes and also overnight. He is so excited to see her when he arrives, and she sends plenty of photos and videos, so I know that he is doing okay while he is there. I would absolutely recommend Dawn, she is brilliant!

Me & Purdy (my 12 month wire haired dachshund) love going to classes run by Dawn. Purdy, a crazy free-spirit, has benefitted from socialising with other dogs & has come on leaps & bounds since we started going. She is much more disciplined now & actually looks forward to classes

Aurora dog training has been life changing for my GSD. Dawn has taken time to get to know my dog’s ways. She has great knowledge, is always happy to help with guidance and support. Dawn is open and approachable. I love that she says what she sees, I. A kind way and always gives help to mould better behaviour, both for me and the dog. My dog has achieved so much with the training.  The classes are great fun, everyone cheers each other’s dog on and wants the best for each individual. Support is tailored to match where your dog is age and stage wise. With classes on different evenings it’s so easy to catch one. Dawn also offers 1-1 home support, which was so amazing. Having someone come to my home to see the dog in situ helped enormously.  There are also group walks some weekends which give opportunities to practice everything that’s been learned in the classes.
Brilliant !! Very helpful , Good trainer, a happy club

I have a very difficult dog. I felt nervous for both of us starting training, even though I was at my wits end and knew it was needed. Dawn made me feel completely at ease from the start. She has so much patience with dogs and owners! I have had both 1:1 and group sessions. She adapts things to suit the needs of the dog and will answer endless questions and give as much advice as you need! Without her, I am sure my dog would not be part of my life now. She has been an endless support and would whole heartedly recommend Dawn for all training needs.

When we first started attending Auroara's dog training we honestly believed our 40kg dog was a reactive goofball with a few sandwiches short of a picnic! With reassurance and guidance our dog has come on leaps and bounds, still a few sandwiches short of a full picnic but that's his personality 😀 Dawn has been amazing and has worked wonders with our dog and we couldn't recommend her highly enough.

Amazing training and advice. Training in a friendly local venue and not overwhelming. Dawn is patient and teaches the whole group but give tailored advice and 1:1 support for your dog. Our dog is now walking really well and we feel we have given him and us the best start with our puppy. Value for money and you meet like minded people and pets ❤️

We  left our five month old Cavapoo Quinn with Dawn for a whole day and she treated him like he was her own We have also had 121 training with her which really opened my eyes to where I was going wrong.
Dawn is such an amazing kind patient lady who first and last though is that your dog is well looked after
A fantastic training experience.
